title: Rahu, Ketu and Balance
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 28 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Rahu and Ketu as one pair, the seesaw, self-checks, home vastu, Ketu in every house and remedies.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 28, Planet Rahu and Ketu by Brajesh Gautam: balancing the pair, remedies, home checks, Ketu by house and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Rahu and Ketu are one pair.
Head and body, Sun side and Moon side. If one rises, the other falls.
Witness mind steadies Rahu. Service and giving steady Ketu. Too much of either breaks the other.
A scattered wish does not manifest. Borrow a guru's head if yours is not working.
Each planet has a home sign.
Fix the sign first, then the planet. Stones come second.
Keep it still and clean, cover the drains, repair broken things.
From the worst in the 3rd to a rocket in the 12th, with what each one does to money, marriage and work.
No gold or silver idols at home.
Clay or wood. Gold is Jupiter and Lakshmi is Venus.
